outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the drawer and aligns its fingers around the silver handle (frames 30–74, wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 90–110, image and left_ego_image), then releases the handle and withdraws (frames 116–172, wrist_image and left_ego_image). The drawer remains visibly open at frame 172 in image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is established.
